title: Cardmember Deposit Reduction — Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards and Alterations Deposits
content:
Holders of Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards receive a cardmember deposit reduction, taken off the deposit rate of a Marlowe & Finch Alterations ticket:

| Card accounts the customer holds | Cardmember deposit reduction |
|---|---|
| An active Marlowe & Finch Store Card Elite or Marlowe & Finch World Elite Mastercard account | 5 percentage points |
| Active Marlowe & Finch card accounts, none of which is one of those two | 2 percentage points |
| No active Marlowe & Finch card account | none |

**Records read.** The customer's card accounts: which card each is and whether it is active.

## Basis Q&A

**A customer holds an active Store Card Plus and an active World Elite Mastercard. Which line applies?** The first: an active World Elite Mastercard account is held, so the reduction is 5 percentage points.

**A customer's only card account is a Store Card Elite that is closed.** No active Marlowe & Finch card account is held: no reduction.

**A customer holds an active Marlowe & Finch Mastercard only.** Active Marlowe & Finch card accounts are held, none an Elite-level card: 2 percentage points.
